_comment: Example schedule queue for the task-scheduler engine. Copy to schedule.json and edit. The running scheduler re-reads this file, so you can add/remove/enable tasks without restarting it. `type: claude` runs a Claude Code CLI prompt from instructionFile; `type: command` runs a shell command. Times are cron (server local time). Replace projectRoot with your own workspace absolute path.

tasks.name: example-claude-task
tasks.description: Example: run a Claude prompt from a markdown instruction file every morning at 7am.

tasks.name: example-command-task
tasks.description: Example: run a shell command on a schedule (here, every 6 hours).

tasks.name: example-watchdog
tasks.description: Example: keep a long-running process alive; cron every minute, engine no-ops if already running.
